verses.text: But realize this, that in the last days difficult times will come.
verses.textZh: 你該知道，末世必有危險的日子來到。

verses.text: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, revilers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,
verses.textZh: 因為那時人要專顧自己、貪愛錢財、自誇、狂傲、謗讟、違背父母、忘恩負義、心不聖潔、

verses.text: unloving, irreconcilable, malicious gossips, without self-control, brutal, haters of good,
verses.textZh: 無親情、不解怨、好說讒言、不能自約、性情兇暴、不愛良善、

verses.text: treacherous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
verses.textZh: 賣主賣友、任意妄為、自高自大、愛宴樂、不愛神，

verses.text: holding to a form of godliness, although they have denied its power; Avoid such men as these.
verses.textZh: 有敬虔的外貌，卻背了敬虔的實意；這等人你要躲開。

verses.text: For among them are those who enter into households and captivate weak women weighed down with sins, led on by various impulses,
verses.textZh: 那偷進人家、牢籠無知婦女的，正是這等人。這些婦女擔負罪惡，被各樣的私慾引誘，

verses.text: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.textZh: 常常學習，終久不能明白真道。

verses.text: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these [men] also oppose the truth, men of depraved mind, rejected in regard to the faith.
verses.textZh: 從前雅尼和佯庇怎樣敵擋摩西，這等人也怎樣敵擋真道。他們的心地壞了，在真道上是可廢棄的。

verses.text: But they will not make further progress; for their folly will be obvious to all, just as Jannes's and Jambres's folly was also.
verses.textZh: 然而他們不能再這樣敵擋；因為他們的愚昧必在眾人面前顯露出來，像那二人一樣。

verses.text: Now you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, perseverance,
verses.textZh: 但你已經服從了我的教訓、品行、志向、信心、寬容、愛心、忍耐，

verses.text: persecutions, [and] sufferings, such as happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium [and] at Lystra; what persecutions I endured, and out of them all the Lord rescued me!
verses.textZh: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的逼迫，苦難。我所忍受是何等的逼迫；但從這一切苦難中，主都把我救出來了。

verses.text: Indeed, all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
verses.textZh: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶穌裡敬虔度日的也都要受逼迫。

verses.text: But evil men and impostors will proceed [from bad] to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.textZh: 只是作惡的和迷惑人的，必越久越惡，他欺哄人，也被人欺哄。

verses.text: You, however, continue in the things you have learned and become convinced of, knowing from whom you have learned [them],
verses.textZh: 但你所學習的，所確信的，要存在心裡；因為你知道是跟誰學的，

verses.text: and that from childhood you have known the sacred writings which are able to give you the wisdom that leads to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textZh: 並且知道你是從小明白聖經，這聖經能使你因信基督耶穌，有得救的智慧。

verses.text: All Scripture is inspired by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for training in righteousness;
verses.textZh: 聖經都是神所默示的（或作：凡神所默示的聖經），於教訓、督責、使人歸正、教導人學義都是有益的，

verses.text: so that the man of God may be adequate, equipped for every good work.
verses.textZh: 叫屬神的人得以完全，預備行各樣的善事。
